- Leftover `.tmp` files from killed launches are never cleaned up. Nothing reads them.
lessons:
- When a spec revises a settled point, list the earlier builder cases that test that point in the engineer's paths. Missing that cost one extra engineer iteration.
- A TMPDIR under `~/gov-os-runs` makes `test_runs.py::test_a_project_under_the_root_gets_no_folder_made_or_added` fail. It is a test-environment artefact; use /tmp.
